fairness_definition: equal geographic representation with two teaching awards in each of 14 counties
selection_order: source-independent stable teaching order within county
tie_breaker: SHA-256 of rule ID seed and tract key
main_tradeoff: county equality ignores population, modeled prevalence, access, capacity, review, and burden
status: accepted comparator; not an action rule

fairness_definition: greater fictional attention to higher accepted modeled area-level prevalence
candidate_filter: all 1597 accepted estimates with limited-support rows retained and labeled
selection_order: modeled prevalence descending, interval width ascending, stable tie breaker
tie_breaker: SHA-256 of rule ID seed and tract key
main_tradeoff: concentrates 26 of 28 awards in limited-support rows and treats modeled context as if it could order action

fairness_definition: feasible fictional delivery under the fixed resource constraint
candidate_filter: fictional capacity of at least 10 places
selection_order: capacity, staff readiness, access readiness, burden, travel, stable tie breaker
tie_breaker: SHA-256 of rule ID seed and tract key
main_tradeoff: favors places that already have more fictional capacity and covers only eight counties

fairness_definition: procedural readiness with fictional review, access, objection, recourse, and county concentration limits
candidate_filter: ready review, no unresolved objection, both access plans ready, capacity of at least 10 places
selection_order: unresolved questions, burden, capacity, modeled context, stable tie breaker, maximum three awards per county
tie_breaker: SHA-256 of rule ID seed and tract key
main_tradeoff: incomplete review can delay or exclude areas, while the base result still has staff and travel concerns
status: least unacceptable planning candidate with conditions; no action authority
